research_result.description: Ahrefs provides SEO, marketing, and search data—including backlinks, organic and paid traffic, keyword metrics, site audits, rank tracking, and AI brand visibility—via REST API v3 endpoints and a hosted remote MCP server.
research_result.credential_requirements: API and MCP server access require a paid Lite or higher subscription plan. Workspace owners and admins can generate API keys or MCP-scoped keys from Account Settings > API Keys, or connect via OAuth 2.0 authorization flows.

evidence.claim: Ahrefs API v3 provides programmatic access to SEO, marketing, and search data organized into REST endpoint tools.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Ahrefs API v3 gives programmatic access to Ahrefs' SEO, marketing, and AI-search data — backlinks, organic and paid traffic, keywords, SERPs, rank tracking, site audits, brand/AI-search visibility, web and social analytics, and account management.

evidence.claim: Accessing API v3 and the MCP server requires a Lite or higher subscription plan.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Using API v3 from any of the above methods is possible for Lite and higher subscription plans, and consume from the same API & Integrations limit.

evidence.claim: Ahrefs supports authentication via HTTP Bearer API keys and OAuth 2.0 authorization code flows.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Ahrefs secures its APIs with http and oauth2 across 3 declared security schemes, as derived from its OpenAPI definitions.

evidence.claim: Ahrefs provides an official hosted Model Context Protocol (MCP) server.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Ahrefs MCP is Ahrefs' official hosted Model Context Protocol server for connecting AI assistants to Ahrefs data.
